basic_details.job_title: MNNIT Allahabad Junior Research Fellow (Biotechnology) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: 28 years on the last date of application for general and EWS (as on last date of application)

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree in Biotechnology/ Life Sciences/ Biochemistry or other relevant branch with 60% marks and valid GATE/ NET/ Equivalent National level examination score
qualification.details: Qualification: Master's degree (M.Sc., M. Pharm, M. Tech) in Biotechnology/ Life Sciences/ Biochemistry or other relevant branch with a minimum percentage of 60%; A valid GATE/ NET/ Equivalent National level examination score Age limit: 28 years on the last date of application for general and EWS (as on last date of application) Age relaxation: OBC (Non-creamy layer) 3 years, SC/ST/PH and women candidates 5 years | Desirable: | Hands-on experience with animal cell culture and molecular biology techniques.

how_to_apply: Fill the prescribed application form available in the notification.
Send the completed application by post to Research & Consultancy Cell, Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad, Prayagraj-211004 within 21 days from publication of the advertisement.
Superscribe the envelope as Application for the post of Project Assistant (on contract) in the Research Project.
Send a soft copy of the application via email to Dr. Ekta Srivastava at [email protected].
Make sure it reaches by 18 November 2026.
important_instructions: The applicant will be responsible for the authenticity of information, other documents and photographs submitted. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's degree (M.Sc., M. Pharm, M. Tech) in Biotechnology/ Life Sciences/ Biochemistry or other relevant branch with a minimum percentage of 60%; A valid GATE/ NET/ Equivalent National level examination score Age limit: 28 years on the last date of application for general and EWS (as on last date of application) Age relaxation: OBC (Non-creamy layer) 3 years, SC/ST/PH and women candidates 5 years Desirable: Hands-on experience with animal cell culture and molecular biology techniques.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Tenure of 1 year, extension based on performance.

content_sections.heading: How Will MNNIT Allahabad Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on merit and project needs Interview of shortlisted candidates Shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail about interview dates. Shortlisted candidates must present themselves with an updated CV and original and attested photocopies of mark sheets/certificates.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Proof of Date of Birth Mark sheets & certificates of all the examinations passed Category Certificate, if applicable GATE/ NET score card, if qualified Experience certificate, if any List of Research Publications (Journals and Conferences), if any No Objection Certificate from employer (if in employment)

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The applicant will be responsible for the authenticity of information, other documents and photographs submitted. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Pages 2 and 3 of the PDF notification) and send it to Research & Consultancy Cell, Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad, Prayagraj-211004, by by post and email, to reach by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 28 years on the last date of application for general and EWS (as on last date of application). Relaxation: OBC (Non-creamy layer) 3 years, SC/ST/PH and women candidates 5 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 37,000 per month (Consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree in Biotechnology/ Life Sciences/ Biochemistry or other relevant branch with 60% marks and valid GATE/ NET/ Equivalent National level examination score.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on merit and project needs. Interview of shortlisted candidates. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail about interview dates. Shortlisted candidates must present themselves with an updated CV and original and attested photocopies of mark sheets/certificates.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tenure of 1 year, extension based on performance.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Allahabad, Prayagraj.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Proof of Date of Birth; Mark sheets & certificates of all the examinations passed; Category Certificate, if applicable; GATE/ NET score card, if qualified; Experience certificate, if any; List of Research Publications (Journals and Conferences), if any.
